subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The patch is a narrow fix for the reported log flood, but the remaining choice is maintainer intent around a SecretRef execution boundary rather than a mechanical contributor repair.

options.title: Accept the guarded skip
options.body: Land the PR after base refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as intended command-secret behavior.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject or pause this PR and tolerate the current expected `UNAVAILABLE` noise until a gateway-owned resolver contract is designed.

options.title: Require runtime-side redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a broader gateway/runtime-command-secret change if maintainers want partial snapshot success instead of a CLI preflight skip.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded skip
recommendation.body: Land the PR after base refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as intended command-secret behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR is assigned to `steipete`, and the remaining decision is acceptance of the auth/security boundary.
